as_told.title: Karl Nell on a secret decades-long arms race

plain: The United States is in a secret race with Russia and China to "reverse engineer" unknown craft, meaning to take them apart and learn how they work, according to Karl Nell, a retired Army officer who helped set up Army Futures Command, the Army's modernisation command. Michels tells this several times, citing what Nell said to The Debrief, an online news site. In one version Michels calls Nell his friend and says the race is going on "right now" against "the Russians and the Chinese". In another he calls it a sub rosa, or secret, conflict that has "been going on for decades", and he connects it to David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who testified to Congress about hidden programmes. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb also repeats Nell. He leaves out Russia and China and simply says, "we actively have crafts and we're actively figuring out how to work various systems with them." Every one of these tellers is passing on Nell's words, not anything they saw themselves. If Nell is right, the US already holds such craft and other powers are racing to understand them too.
